_enforcement.note: This file is the authoritative design contract, NOT runtime-enforced middleware. Routes in index.js do not check this registry before executing. Enforcement target: capabilities-as-middleware in a future phase. Until then, this file serves as the human-readable permission matrix and drift tracker.

principles.no_undeclared_endpoints: INTENT — every API route should map to a declared capability here. Currently descriptive, not enforced.
principles.chat_and_web_parity: INTENT — chat and UI should have access to the same capability set.
principles.audit_and_event_required: ENFORCED — emitsEvent/writesAudit fields are accurate per implementation.
principles.permission_matrix_is_source_of_truth: INTENT — callers/roles/kyc declared here should match route guards in index.js.
principles.lego_model_add_only: ENFORCED — never silently modify an existing capability id; create v2.

Create a long-form creative project (novel, screenplay, stageplay) with byline, output formats, and reference tones.

Upsert a character bible entry — psychology, voice markers, biographical facts, arc-per-chapter.

Push manuscript to Amazon KDP. v1 generates manifest for manual upload; supervised-browser automation later.

Scaffold a three-phase launch campaign (pre-launch buzz, launch week, sustained press) for a creative project.
Build a literary press target list for a creative project. v1 uses a canonical 30-outlet list; tenant merge in v1.1.

Apply a per-tenant overlay to a worker (changes its rules/prompt/config for this tenant only, never the shared base).
Propose a change to a worker's behavior. Creates a pending proposal; nothing is applied until approved.

Reject a pending worker change. Nothing is applied.
Advisor affirms their already-signed agreement; mints it as a DTC in their personal Vault + records an append-only attestation.
Create a new Digital Title Certificate in the personal Vault (home, vehicle, credentials, health, money).

Query personal Vault assets by type or keyword. Used by workers to find dtcId before logbook writes.
Draft and schedule a social media post (X, YouTube, TikTok) with optional Fal.ai-generated image. Requires human approval.
Send or schedule a marketing email blast to a contact list via SendGrid. Requires human approval.
Create a named email contact list in SendGrid and sync to Firestore.
Generate campaign creative (images, copy) via Fal.ai image generation. Subject to RAAS image governance (NSFW gate, no real-location fabrication).

Enqueue a scheduled message (email/SMS/telegram) for future delivery. Processed by messageQueueProcessor every 15 min.
Connect Google Drive or OneDrive via OAuth. Stores encrypted tokens per-user.

Fetch live METAR/TAF/SIGMET from aviationweather.gov for a given station or area.
Fetch FAA NASR runway pavement polygons and derived threshold ground-control-points for an airport — free, keyless; used for our own Airport Diagram georeferencing.
Fetch real FAA d-TPP chart list (approach plates, airport diagram) for one ICAO airport, each with a currently-valid PDF URL — free, keyless.
Fetch live pilot reports (PIREPs) from aviationweather.gov within a radius of a lat/lon point — free, keyless.
Fetch active NOTAMs from Notamify (paid/metered). Requires NOTAMIFY_API_KEY.
Fetch real-time ADS-B traffic from ADS-B Exchange (paid/metered). Requires ADSB_API_KEY.
Check pilot currency status (day/night IFR/recent landings) against FAR requirements from Vault logbook data.

CODEX S52.56 (Garcia customer portal) — read a title order's status, documents, and closing details for the specific customer (buyer/seller/borrower) entitled to that order, via the client-facing portal. Read-only; process/status information only, not legal or closing advice. Entitlement enforced by matching the caller's authenticated email against the contact record linked to the requested order.

2026-08-21 gap-audit fix — pilot logs a flight to their personal Vault logbook (append-only aviation.flight record in logbookEntries). Dispatched by POST /v1/logbook:flight:add (functions/functions/index.js), the same write shape as the existing chat-based log_flight tool on the universal Alex Chief-of-Staff persona. Wired to the "+ Log Flight" button on the Aviation CoPilot worker canvas (AviationWorkerCanvas.jsx). 2026-08-21 — dispatch/releasing-authority issues a flight release BEFORE a pilot may fly it (Part 135 operational control / Part 91 dispatch record — see 14 CFR 135.77 and neighboring sections for the Part 135 operational-control area). Writes a new flightReleases/{releaseId} record: tail number, route, proposed departure time, PIC/SIC, operation type, weather-briefing and W&B acknowledgement, fuel load, releasing authority, status. Dispatched by POST /v1/aviation:dispatch:releaseFlight (functions/functions/index.js). Wired to the "+ Release Flight" button on the Dispatch worker canvas (av-dispatch / av-dispatch-001). Independent of aviation.log_flight_v1 — whether a pilot's flight log should be required to reference an active release is an open design question, intentionally not enforced here.

2026-09-04 — 'no penmanship, no pilot math' (Sean, CAN-as-centerpiece directive). Real Anthropic vision call reads a photographed panel hour meter (Hobbs, engine hours, etc.), identifies which meter it is, and computes the delta against the aircraft's last logged reading for that meter. Propose-only: never writes to the aircraft record itself — returns a confidence-scored reading (verified this session against a real panel photo: correctly flagged an upside-down mechanical meter as low-confidence rather than guessing) for a human to confirm or correct before aviation.commit_meter_reading_v1 is called. Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:readMeterPhoto (functions/functions/index.js, services/mx/aircraftRecords.js).

2026-09-04 — the confirm half of the meter-reading flow: writes a human-confirmed (or human-corrected) meter reading to aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft/{tailNumber}.meters.{meterType}, deliberately separate from aviation.read_meter_photo_v1 so a vision misread can never reach the aircraft's legal record without a human confirming the number first. Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:commitMeterReading.

2026-09-05 gap-audit fix, consolidated same day — files a real discrepancy against aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft/{tailNumber}/squawks via the shared addSquawkCore write path (services/mx/aircraftRecords.js), used identically by the manual '+ File Squawk' button (AviationWorkerCanvas.jsx), the chat file_squawk tool, and the photo path (aviation.read_squawk_photo_v1 / aviation.commit_squawk_photo_v1) — one write path regardless of entry method. Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:addSquawk. The older disconnected read path (GET /v1/aviation:squawks, tenants/{tenantId}/squawks) has been removed — it held zero real documents and was never the same collection computeAirworthiness() reads; aviation.list_squawks_v1 is the real replacement.

2026-09-05 gap-audit fix — the Corrective Action half: closes or defers (with a required MEL category A/B/C/D) an open squawk on aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft/{tailNumber}/squawks/{squawkId} (services/mx/aircraftRecords.js handleUpdateSquawkStatus), a pre-existing backend route that had never been registered here. Wired to the new per-squawk "Take action" button on the MX Tracker worker canvas's Corrective Action panel, which reads real open squawks from GET /v1/mx:listAircraft (computeAirworthiness output) so the list shown matches what this action operates on. Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:updateSquawkStatus.

2026-09-05 — real fleet squawk log (open + closed) across every tail on file for the scope, sourced from aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft/{tailNumber}/squawks (services/mx/aircraftRecords.js handleListSquawks). Replaces the read-only 'Squawks' tab's prior source (GET /v1/aviation:squawks, a disconnected flat collection that held zero real documents and was removed same day). Dispatched by GET /v1/mx:listSquawks.

2026-09-05 — photo-based squawk entry, the 'propose' half (Sean: 'voice or chat is best, but a photo is better, worst case a form'). Vision call over a photo of visible damage/a warning light/a worn part/etc. returns a DRAFT description + confidence, same honesty pattern as aviation.read_meter_photo_v1 — an unclear photo returns isUnclear rather than inventing a plausible discrepancy. Writes nothing; requiresManualConfirmation is always true (a squawk is a legal record). Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:readSquawkPhoto.

2026-09-05 — the confirm half of photo-based squawk entry: after the pilot reviews/edits the draft from aviation.read_squawk_photo_v1, files it through the same real addSquawkCore write path as the manual form and chat (source:"photo" tagged for traceability), deliberately separate from the read step so a vision misread never reaches the aircraft's legal record without a human confirming it first. Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:commitSquawkPhoto.

2026-09-05 MX deep-dive — MX To-Do: adds one real scheduled-maintenance item (inspection interval, recurring due item; hours- or calendar-based) to a tail's record (aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft/{tailNumber}.maintenanceItems, via arrayUnion). Evaluated on every read by airworthinessTracker.evaluateMaintenanceItems — mandatory items overdue contribute to the tail's computed RED airworthiness status and blockingItems, same as the pre-existing single nextInspection field this generalizes. Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:addMaintenanceItem (services/mx/aircraftRecords.js).

2026-09-05 MX deep-dive — adds a component/engine/avionics warranty or coverage-plan record (e.g. PT6A Eagle Service Plan) to a tail's record (aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft/{tailNumber}.warranties, via arrayUnion). Evaluated by airworthinessTracker.evaluateWarranties — informational only; never contributes to the tail's airworthiness status (warranty expiration is a cost/coverage concern, not a safety one). Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:addWarranty (services/mx/aircraftRecords.js).

2026-09-05 MX deep-dive — NEF (Negative Equipment List, per CODEX 40 §8): documents one piece of equipment NOT installed that would otherwise be required (distinct from MEL, which covers installed-but-inoperative equipment). Appends to aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft/{tailNumber}.nefItems via arrayUnion. Pure documentation record — no status computed, never blocks airworthiness. Dispatched by POST /v1/mx:addNefItem (services/mx/aircraftRecords.js).

2026-09-05 Dispatch deep-dive — ingests a mission request (aircraft type/category, mission type e.g. medevac/training/cargo, min seats, IFR requirement, cargo capacity) and scores/ranks it against the REAL fleet on file (aircraftRecords/{scopeId}/aircraft), merging each tail's computed airworthiness (computeAirworthiness) and optional capabilities profile. Never fabricates a fleet match — an empty or non-matching fleet returns an honest 'no match' with the real fleet size, not a plausible-looking fake tail. Dispatched by POST /v1/dispatch:matchAircraft (services/dispatch/aircraftMatching.js). Feeds aviation.create_trip_request_v1's tailNumber field once a candidate is picked.

Real trip-generation object for Dispatch (dispatchTripRequests/{scopeId}/requests/{id}) — client, destination/alternate, pax manifest, ground transport, assigned crew, tail assignment. As of 2026-09-05 also accepts an optional missionRequest snapshot (what was actually asked for) and matchReasons (why the assigned tail was picked, from aviation.match_aircraft_v1) so the tail assignment is auditable against the original ask rather than a bare tail number with no recorded justification. Dispatched by POST /v1/dispatch:createTripRequest (services/dispatch/tripRequests.js). Pre-existing capability, registered here for the first time as part of the 2026-09-05 MX/Dispatch deep-dive.

CODEX 84 — read-only, tenant-scoped lookup of a SKU's real dppProducts record (passportStatus, registryId, capacityKwh, dppInScope, batteryCategory), zero side effects. Closes the gap CODEX 74 §9.2 first proposed as ecommerce.shopify_passport_status_read_v1 and never built. Reads only dppProducts, not productPassports — every field returned already lives there, no schema-merge needed for this scope. Dispatched by GET /v1/dpp:worker:passportStatus (functions/functions/index.js).

CODEX 84 — bulk product intake for the DPP vertical, generalizing dpp:shopify:selfServeIntake's per-SKU scope determination into real multi-row ingestion with per-row accept/reject (a malformed or duplicate row doesn't fail the whole batch). Writes one dppImports doc per batch (results per row, created/skipped/failed counts) rather than using the platform-wide imports/ collection, which is an audit-log stub with no real parsing (CODEX 84 §2.3) — that broader fix is tracked separately and doesn't block this. Dispatched by POST /v1/dpp:worker:bulkIntake (functions/functions/index.js).
